title: Journal entries
text: Every entry in the books, newest first. Posted entries never change; reverse them to undo.

approvals.title: Entries to approve
approvals.text: Entries above the approval amount wait here for a second person. You cannot approve entries you wrote or sent.

list.empty_text: Write the first entry: money in, money out, or anything that moves between accounts.
list.none_text: Try another number or date, or clear the filters.
list.approvals_empty_text: Entries waiting for a second person appear here.

not_set_up.title: The books are not set up yet
not_set_up.text: Choose a starting list of accounts and the first fiscal year. It takes a minute.
not_set_up.ask: Ask someone who manages the books to set them up.

form.text: Debits and credits must be equal. Save a draft at any time, or send it when it balances.
form.narration_hint: What happened, e.g. "Office rent for October".
form.invalid_amount: Enter an amount like 1250.50, on one side only.
form.not_editable: Only drafts and rejected entries can be changed.

journal.waiting_note: Waiting for someone who may approve entries. You can take it back to change it.
journal.delete_text: The draft is removed for good. Posted entries are never removed.

done.reject: Entry sent back to its writer.

journal.reject_text: Say what to fix; the writer sees it.
journal.reverse_text: A new entry with debits and credits swapped undoes this one. Both stay in the books.
journal.approve_text: Entry {number} goes into the books for {amount}. Posted entries can only be reversed.
journal.conflict: Someone changed this entry meanwhile. It was reloaded.

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.text: Every account of the company, grouped. Accounts with entries are archived, never deleted.
accounts.is_group: Group heading (holds other accounts, takes no entries)
accounts.archive_text: It stays in reports and history but takes no new entries. You can use it again later.
accounts.empty_text: Set up the books to start with a ready list of accounts.

reports.title: Reports
reports.text: From posted entries only. Choose the dates, and a branch or department if you like.
reports.nothing: No posted entries in this period.
reports.pick_account: Choose an account to see its entries.

setup.title: Set up the books
setup.text: Choose a starting list of accounts. You can rename, add and archive accounts afterwards.
setup.first_year: First day of the first fiscal year
setup.first_year_hint: Leave empty to use the company's fiscal year start ({date}).
setup.already_text: Change accounts in the chart of accounts and add fiscal years when needed.
setup.no_permission: Only people who manage the books can set them up.

fiscal.title: Fiscal years
fiscal.text: Entries go into open periods only. Close a month once it is checked; reopening needs a reason.
fiscal.close_text: Nobody can post entries dated in this period until someone reopens it.
fiscal.reopen_text: Say why the period is reopened; it goes into the audit log.

posting.title: Posting accounts
posting.text: Other modules (payroll, sales, stock) post to the accounts you choose here. Choose an account of the type shown.
posting.empty: No module posts to Accounting yet.

common.conflict: Someone changed this meanwhile. It was reloaded.
